data.title: Mangawhai Collective’s Partial Takeover of Bremworth Reaches 11% Acceptances
data.description:

Mangawhai Collective Limited has notified Bremworth Limited, the Takeovers Panel and NZX that acceptances under its partial takeover offer have reached 11.00% of Bremworth’s issued ordinary shares as of 14 September 2026. data.title: Muthoot Microfin Raises ₹250 Crore via NCDs to Support Growth and Lower Funding Costs
data.description:

Muthoot Microfin Ltd. has raised ₹250 crore via a private placement of listed, rated, secured and redeemable non-convertible debentures, which will be listed on BSE Limited. The issuance comprises 2,50,000 debentures of ₹10,000 each, with a 24‑month tenure and a 9.25% annual coupon payable monthly, and is backed by a first‑ranking exclusive charge over the company’s receivables.

The fund raise is part of the company’s strategy to strengthen its funding profile, diversify its liability mix and reduce borrowing costs, following a 75‑basis‑point decline in its cost of funds in FY26. Supported by a recent credit rating upgrade to CRISIL AA‑/Stable, the transaction underscores investor confidence and is expected to help Muthoot Microfin improve margins while pursuing responsible growth and expanding its customer base across its markets.

data.title: EBOS Releases FY2026 Climate Statement Under New Zealand Climate Standards
data.description:

EBOS Group Limited has released its FY2026 Climate Statement, the third mandatory climate-related disclosure prepared under Aotearoa New Zealand Climate Standards for the year to 30 June 2026. The report targets investors and creditors, outlining material climate-related matters alongside the Group’s wider ESG activities.

The statement details EBOS’ governance, risk management, strategy, metrics and targets for climate-related risks and opportunities, while acknowledging significant uncertainties and reliance on evolving data and third-party inputs. It highlights key risk factors that could affect the Group’s transition plan and emissions targets, including regulatory changes, approval and infrastructure risks for planned solar arrays, and the availability and cost of carbon credits, certificates and renewable energy, particularly at leased sites where landlord cooperation is required.
